children: enGene reported third-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $266.3 million and a net loss of $32.5 million (approximately $0.47 per share). The company said total operating expenses were $34.0 million for the quarter and reiterated plans to initiate a Biologics License Application (BLA) filing for detalimogene in 4Q 2026. enGene also disclosed progress in its LEGEND trial, including surfactant cohort safety clearance and planned data updates and a pre-BLA meeting with the FDA in 4Q 2026.
Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities: $266.3 million as of July 31, 2026.
Total operating expenses: $34.0 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026.
Research and development expense: $20.09 million for the quarter.
General and administrative expense: $13.924 million for the quarter.
Net loss attributable to common shareholders: $32.5 million for the quarter; net loss per share, basic and diluted: $0.47.

Regulatory and development milestones: Pre-BLA meeting with the FDA and initiation of a BLA submission for detalimogene planned in 4Q 2026; potential FDA decision and platform designation anticipated in 2027.
LEGEND trial progress: Updated regulatory endpoint data (CR at any time and DOR ≥12 months) and landmark CR rates from the pivotal Cohort 1 are planned for 4Q 2026.

Surfactant cohort: Safety run-in for a polidocanol surfactant bladder rinse combined with detalimogene successfully cleared; company to host a KOL webinar on October 15, 2026 detailing preclinical surfactant data and enrollment guidance.

Clinical profile and positioning: Company highlights detalimogene’s localized IL-12 expression, potential best-in-class tolerability, office-based administration, and the DDX non-viral delivery platform intended to simplify manufacturing, handling and administration.
Corporate governance: Michael Heffernan assumed the role of Chairman of the Board in July 2026 to support regulatory milestones and commercial readiness planning.
